delivery: Unreleased incremental source work. No version bump, commit, push, installer or installation.
scope: Ordinary author-owned registered JSON recipe documents reuse existing create, save, optimistic revision and complete archive workflows.

Portable read-only inspection derives all fragment actor definitions and all template/override image references from current source, including unused fragments and shadowed images; metadata is never rewritten.

Selective resource package catalog, reader and importer validate recognized recipes and their declared dependencies, preserve source/UUID, retain projection closure and reject omitted or miscategorized manifest dependencies.
Registered-document CLI validates current source revision and reference registration, emits detached Scene2D v3 or bundle with logical origin; no write or automatic rebuild.
harnessCorrections: Initial browser fixture used an invalid slash in workspace name; corrected the synthetic name.
Browser create wait incorrectly compared the editor docs-standard preview alias against a raw document path; ordinary save had already succeeded. Fixed test path normalization.
Added missing v3 template snapshot files to the disposable browser fixture and asserted the UI error panel stays empty. Final workflow passed; no product changes were needed for these harness issues.
limits: Existing source editor and package UI support ordinary recipe documents. No dedicated recipe preview, placement/override GUI, automatic baked-scene synchronization or reverse source write-back.

Registered CLI verifies declared reference availability and image kind, not actual image bytes or runtime feasibility; existing scene/model/build validation remains responsible for runtime acceptance.

Malformed recognized recipes can be saved and fully backed up; selective resource packages reject them. Removing the top-level format marker makes an ordinary document and exits derived recipe semantics.
Single-file fragments, explicit UUID maps, bounded expansion and existing Scene2D v3 remain unchanged. No nested/cross-file compositions, scripts, spatial group transforms or multi-file transaction.
Native mobile storage and packaged platform tests ran on Linux. No Android device, Tauri window or installer acceptance in this round.
